label: Rival: modal collapse holds at some world accessible from the route's world
paraphrase: Rival (possible collapse, the premise of collapse-propagation arguments), analyst formulation: full modal collapse (MC F allPredicates) holds at some world accessible from w on the route's frame. In K and KT it is compatible with an actual contingent being (CONTINGENT-NODE-CONTROLS, step and false-le-true frames); it is a rival of the contingency node on the KTB and S5 readings of NECESSARY_2.
